summary: Frontend-only verification of the new BrunoLoader (corporate loading screen) and new favicon/app icons across ~22 pages. All acceptance criteria pass: loader renders with correct data-testids, mascot images load from /brand/*.webp, progress ramps up (~10%→~40% over 500ms) and detaches cleanly after network resolves, the transient bruno-loader-finish ghost is removed within ~1.5s. Pose rotation cycles wave→laptop→walk across consecutive full-page loads (observed walk, wave, laptop). Tone attribute alternates theme/orange as designed. No BrunoLoader-related, no Loader2-undefined and no 'Compiled with problems' errors on any of 10 audited pages. All required static assets return 200 with correct image content-type. manifest.json already references /bruno-app-icon-512.png?v=11 and theme_color #FF6A00. Interactivity confirmed post-load on /my-profile (Editar perfil clickable, no invisible overlay).

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: <span> injected by ve-dynamic wrapper inside <select> and inside <option> (translate-language-select). Not caused by this iteration but visible in console; consider guarding these elements from the visual-editor wrapper.

critical_code_review_comments: BrunoLoader.jsx uses fixed z-[10000] and a 620ms detached ghost with pointer-events:none — good, does not block clicks.
Pose index persisted in sessionStorage; note per-tab persistence means fresh tabs restart the cycle — acceptable per spec.
Consider preloading /brand/mascot-*.webp so first render under throttling shows the mascot immediately (currently image can pop in mid-progress).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_92 verified BrunoLoader + icons. Throttling was applied via CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions (latency 1500ms, 200kbps). Pages tested without regressions: /my-profile /chat /settings /marketplace /reels /notifications /store /premium /dashboard /cart. Only remaining console noise is unrelated: 420 status on some external asset and a pre-existing SettingsPage hydration warning from the visual-editor wrapper injecting <span> inside <select>/<option>.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
